messages:
Elena (Reliability): Thanks all — quick follow-up from the all-hands reliability segment. RCA is here: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2198764. I pasted the immediate action items below. Please ack and take ownership where indicated.

Marcus (CTO): Thanks Elena. Two quick Qs: 1) Do we have a customer-facing incident summary draft? 2) Any SLA credits expected so we can prep finance?

Sarah (SRE): I can draft the customer summary. Will pull timeline & impact from the RCA and post in #support-desk for review. No SLA credits expected yet until we finish impact calc, I'll confirm by EOD.

Devon (Product): Can you link the rollback/playbook you used? Want to understand whether this changes the roadmap priority for the cache refactor.

Elena (Reliability): Rollback playbook snippet: ```/playbooks/fallbacks/cache-fallback-v2.md``` — will link full. For roadmap: short term we keep the cache patch; product decision on refactor timing after metrics next sprint.

Leo (Solutions): I'll take the monitoring thresholds task. Can someone give me the signal names? I can add a Prometheus alert set and sample dashboards.

Nadia (People Ops): Heads up — SRE on-call rotation has one vacation overlap next week. If we ask for extra shift coverage, ping me and I’ll help with temporary swaps.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2198764 has been archived and linked to RCA https://internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2198764 :white_check_mark:

Elena (Reliability): Action items (owners + tentative due dates):
- Sarah: Customer-facing summary + status-page blurb (due 2198765000)
- Leo: Update alert thresholds + dashboard (due 2198766000)
- Marcus: Approve customer comms & SLA stance (due 2198765400)
- Devon: Decide roadmap impact (triage meeting Wed)
- Elena: Publish short postmortem snippet for external buyers (due 2198765600)
- Nadia: Support on-call coverage for next two weeks if needed (Ongoing)

Sarah (SRE): Ack — posting draft to #support-desk in 30m.

Marcus (CTO): Ack. If comms show higher risk for customers we may consider a limited SLA credit; will confirm after Sarah's draft.

Leo (Solutions): Taking it. Can someone DM me the exact metric names? I saw `cache_miss_rate` and `fallback_count` in the RCA but want the canonical labels.

Elena (Reliability): Canonical labels: `service_cache_miss_ratio`, `fallback_activation_total`, `latency_p50_p95`. DM me and I'll drop the Grafana links.

Devon (Product): For the triage meeting, can we add a short agenda: 1) severity / recurrence risk 2) product vs infra fix 3) customer comms wording. Wed 10am PT?

Nadia (People Ops): Noted. If we need temporary coverage for on-call, I'll coordinate swap list and approvals.

ops-bot: Task created: "Update status page wording for INC-2198764" assigned to Sarah, due 2198765000.

Elena (Reliability): Quick clarifications from leadership: Marcus will approve comms if no major new impact; Devon will own roadmap decision at Wed triage; Leo + Sarah to finalize monitoring + comms. I'll sync with legal for external wording.

Sarah (SRE): Draft posted: https://internal.redwood.com/drafts/inc-2198764-customer-summary — please review.

Marcus (CTO): Reviewed, left one edit suggestion for tone. Otherwise :+1:.

Leo (Solutions): Done — added Grafana links and example alert thresholds in the dashboard notes.

Elena (Reliability): Great. Can everyone who is assigned paste a one-line confirmation in this thread once their task is complete? We'll close the loop and update the action tracker.

Devon (Product): Confirmed — I’ll update roadmap ticket after Wed triage.

Nadia (People Ops): Standing by for on-call coverage requests.

Sarah (SRE): Confirmed — posted to status page and #support-desk. Marking my task done.

Marcus (CTO): Confirmed — comms approved and SLA stance cleared for now.

Elena (Reliability): Thanks team. Closing this thread once all confirmations are in. If anything pops up, add to the RCA doc comments or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
